clarification_rationale.14: The example-first criterion applies within the proposed design, after the separate constraints section. A concrete load or save behavior example satisfies it; requiring one example to cover the entire load/save lifecycle would add a requirement beyond the design-writing contract. A destination JSON shape alone is not a behavior example.
clarification_rationale.4: Keep the original status-update prompt and frozen failures. The delivery repair explicitly defines absent-goal handling; updating status does not authorize creating a goal.
clarification_rationale.5: Both approved design and skill permit direct primary handling of clear small tasks. Include that existing route without dropping error-contract or authority checks; original frozen grades remain unchanged.
clarification_rationale.15: The decision report must identify primary-owned progress/final acceptance and the bounded future assignment, even when dispatch is deferred.
clarification_rationale.17: Personal role count is caller configuration. Remove the obsolete five-role wording while retaining all assertions, critical expectations and the role-free portability contract.
